name: Office Relocation
short: IT-and-files-first office moves planned to land your team working, over a weekend where possible.
description: Office moves fail on lost cables and missing files, not on furniture. We plan office relocations backwards from your go-live: IT assets crated and sequenced first, files inventoried cabinet by cabinet, workstations labelled per employee map, and move windows chosen to fit your building's freight-lift and permission rules.

features.title: Move plan keyed to go-live
features.text: A documented sequence — IT and server-adjacent assets first, then files, then furniture — so your team resumes work in the shortest practical window.

features.title: IT & electronics crating
features.text: Monitors, CPUs and network gear move in padded crates with anti-static handling; asset tags are logged against the inventory.

features.title: Building permission handling
features.text: Freight-lift bookings, loading-bay slots and security gate formalities at both buildings are coordinated in advance — business parks run on these rules.

features.title: Weekend & overnight moves
features.text: Where building rules allow, moves are scheduled over weekends or overnight to keep downtime close to zero.

faqs.q: Can you move our office over a weekend?
faqs.a: Where both buildings permit weekend work and freight-lift slots are available, yes — that is our default plan for small and mid-size offices. We confirm permissions before committing the date.

faqs.q: How do you handle computers and servers?
faqs.a: IT assets are crated with padding and anti-static handling, tagged against an asset inventory, and moved as the first sequence item so your IT team can start setup early. Rack-mounted or sensitive server equipment gets a scoped plan discussed in the survey.

faqs.q: Do you provide GST invoices for office relocation?
faqs.a: Yes — as a GST-registered business we issue proper tax invoices with GSTIN, which most companies need for accounting. Corporate billing terms can be set up in advance.

faqs.q: What size of office can you handle?
faqs.a: Our sweet spot is small and mid-size offices — roughly 5 to 150 workstations — with one or two trucks and a supervisor-led crew. Larger multi-floor projects are scoped individually after a site visit.
